subject: specprop() fails on low bit rate data

messages.author: e14cfb57d640984d
messages.subject: specprop() fails on low bit rate data
parts:
Hello,

I am using trying to use seewave to calculate acoustic measurements on files which were recorded at a very low bit-rate of 2 kHz.

When I try to run specprop() on these recordings it fails. Since it also fails with the internal "sheep" data set, I'll use that as an example:

> foo = spec(sheep)
> specprop(foo)
Error in specprop(foo) : Frequency resolution is too high (<0.5 hz)


It looks like this is due to specprop() wanting to work with a whole-number frequency grid. I made a few minor adjustments, which change the function so that it uses a real-number frequency grid. I'm attaching a patch. With this patch, specprop() seems to work for low bit rate data, and when I test it against "tico", it returns numbers very close to those returned by an unpatched specprop().

I hope this helps; please let me know if you have any questions!

Best,
Jesse Ross

Jerome has fixed this issue in recent versions of seewave, either by using this patch or by fixing it some other way. If you use update.packages() to update to the latest version of seewave, you should not see this error any more.
